method: Full reads of six pinned files with Git blob and SHA256 validation. Compiled and executed original fdupes rm_fmt_elem with synthetic structures, snprintf substituted for g_snprintf, colors disabled and temporary output stream. No full upstream binary execution.
findings: Treemerge header exposes feed, finish and output callback, but no explicit incomplete/error status return from feed or finish. Header alone does not establish how implementation propagates traversal errors; treemerge.c remains unread.

Shredder header enumerates dormant/start/hashing/finishing/finished states and separates original-selection/forwarding from hashing. No additional content or lifetime guarantee can be inferred from declarations alone.

cmdline.h contains an old-Apple getdelim fallback gated by maximum SDK before 10.7. It preserves NUL delimiters and returns byte count; buffer grows in 128-byte increments. This legacy branch is not exercised on current host.

CSV formatter doubles quotes and quotes entire path, dynamically allocates digest/path strings and emits empty checksum when unavailable. Unique records can expose unfinished digests under configured policies, without a per-record full-hash completion field. fprintf status is ignored.

fdupes formatter stores each formatted record in a fixed 544-byte buffer and ignores snprintf truncation status. Long paths truncate and can lose record separator; newline-containing paths are emitted without escaping. Unique and traversed-directory candidate rows are excluded.

uniques formatter writes full path directly and supports explicit NUL terminator via print0; default newline output cannot unambiguously represent newline-containing names. It applies tagged/untagged policy filters and ignores stream errors.

executed_control.scope: Original function with stub types/macros and libc snprintf, no scanner execution.

limits: No production-library code copied or changed.
